description: Delete one selected owned Library item. Deletion resolves bucket and path from the owned saved row, protects saved actor keeper fronts, removes owned auxiliary files before the primary, and preserves the index if file removal is unconfirmed. External references remove only the owned index. Needs the separate manage:library grant and confirm: true after the owner approved the exact item. Take the assetId from soclo_library_search. Debits no customer credits.
name: soclo_library_delete
title: Delete a Library item
